findings.finding: While the demo plays, Hear it is aria-disabled but .nl-btn--quiet:active still draws the pressed ring, so a press that does nothing looks like it worked (MS-6.7). The disabled look is a site-only copy of the components.css :disabled values and can drift. The drawn Listen button uses --target-cta only for a 64px height.
findings.fix: Add .nl-btn[aria-disabled="true"] beside :disabled in components.css, including box-shadow: none on :active, and drop the site.css copy. Use a spacing sum for the drawn Listen button's height.

findings.finding: The hidden check icon and code slots make the dashed typing chip as wide as the real chip, so for about 2.5 s of each play the word sits behind an empty icon gap and is followed by an empty tail (r4-proof3-1280x800-2560ms.png).
findings.fix: Keep the icon slot (it alone aligns the words) and drop the code slot, or accept the look and record it in design.md 4.2. Recheck with the MS-7.9 edge check and timed screenshots.

findings.finding: Production build and Lighthouse were not re-run on the iteration 3 tree (about 30 CSS rules and hidden markup added). The 100 scores and the 208 of 250 KB transfer are from the iteration 2 tree (MS-11.1, MS-11.2).
findings.fix: Before quoting scores or committing, re-run task 44 (build, next start -p 3202, node scripts/lighthouse.mjs --write) once the person agrees to stop the dev server.

findings.finding: Row 993 still says 'MS-6.7 Hear it disabled while playing' and row 992 'MS-7.4 getHowData() sentences each encode to 44'; both contradict MS-6.7, MS-7.8 and the current tests (tech rule 7).
findings.fix: Change the cells to 'aria-disabled while playing, stays focusable, ignores presses' and 'MS-7.8 getHowData for 4663 with home chosen'.

findings.where: packages/web/components/site/SiteMotion.tsx play leads; Access and Conversation grids
findings.finding: On tall viewports, drawings in different rows show ember rings at the same time during a slow scroll (about 400 px/s): 1,044 ms in total with 2 or more drawings ringing at 1024 x 1366, up to 3 at once, and 250 ms at 1920 x 1080. This touches accessibility rule 3. MS-7.3 and MS-8.11 hold. The V39 note covers only a fast scroll.
findings.fix: Keep a page-wide 'ember busy until' time in SiteMotion and add the remaining time to --play-after; or the product owner accepts it and the V39 note is corrected.

findings.finding: Ember press ring is 1.49:1 to 1.81:1 on light surfaces in Day (8.5:1 to 9.5:1 in Night); accessibility rule 8. WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply (aria-hidden pictures).
findings.fix: In Day, pair the press ring with a 2px plum inner line as the scan ring does; record it in design/system/README.md 'Website drawings' first.

findings.where: KeypadPicture at KEY_DRAWING_SIZE 64px (How picture, How step 1 stage, switch drawing)

findings.fix: For 64px drawn keys only, add about 4px of top padding to .nl-key__letters inside .site .nl-keypad; keys stay 64px (MS-10.8).

findings.where: lib/motion.ts shouldPlay for drawings taller than the play area (How step 1 stage, proof figure)

findings.fix: Play a drawing taller than the viewport only when its top is at or below 0, or show How step 1 finished under about 420px tall, or accept it for the sideways phone.

findings.finding: Keys lose their shapes in forced-colors: active (carried over); the Touch drawing shows two bare '2 ABC' labels with no visible size difference.
findings.fix: @media (forced-colors: active) { .nl-key { border: var(--line-width) solid transparent; } } and check /app, or scope it to .site .nl-key.

findings.finding: Below 1024px the drawings stay small in large stages: at 768 the layouts drawing is 221 x 92 in a 672 x 216 stage and Your view 216 x 188 in a 384px stage; at 768 and 390 Listen fills only the top part of its 288px stage. Phones are the first target.
